integrity: Analytic proof in RESULT.md; standard-library numerical checks provide corroboration, not an infinite proof or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Equal-rate Markov gate, stationary gate initialization, particle-only resetting, one-dimensional Brownian motion and ideal absorption; global minimizer uniqueness proven only for sufficiently small or sufficiently large switching speed; no claim of number of turning points.
title: Reentrant optimal resetting under symmetric switching of a blinking Brownian target
